name: Lua Global Inc
long_description:
Lua is the mid-market agent platform.

We deliver enterprise reliability with the speed, flexibility, and economics that mid-market companies demand - helping them deploy AI agents that drive sales, support, and operations across everyday channels and tools.

We scale through developer agencies and channel partners, enabling rapid distribution without a large enterprise sales motion or scaled forward deployed teams. We think of Lua as an agentOS that abstracts all of the complexity required to launch enterprise grade agents and combine it with the tools needed for these agents to succeed in the real world.

Lua was founded by Lorcan O Cathain (CEO) and Stefan Kruger (CTO)- experienced founders who have spent 15 - 20 years each scaling technology companies across emerging markets.

We sell to mid-market enterprises and developer agencies in the US and internationally. Developers are increasingly our primary ICP but we run SMB & enterprise sales motions to accelerate our learnings and further develop our product:
- SMB ($25- 1k per month): fully automated self-serve agents that handle sales and support for eCommerce companies, hotels, restaurants and general service businesses. If you’ve been on our website you’ve likely seen this.
- Enterprise: We directly sell to mid-market (~ $50M- $1BN) businesses across the US and internationally to eat our own dog food and strengthen our platform.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Co-Founder & CEO of Lua AI- we enable builders to launch enterprise grade AI agents quickly, reliably and at scale. Before co-founding Lua I spent 15 years building and investing in technology companies across emerging markets.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Stefan Kruger is the co founder and CTO of heylua.ai, a chat-first AI platform helping businesses become AI native in a couple of clicks. Before starting Lua, he was VP of Engineering at Paystack (acquired by Stripe), where he spent nearly a decade scaling fintech infrastructure across the continent. A builder at heart, Stefan has deep experience in resilient systems, orchestration, and developer tooling, and is passionate about making AI accessible in the everyday platform

launches.title: Lua AI- the unified agent platform for mid-market enterprises
launches.tagline: We make it easy for enterprises to build, deploy, and scale AI agents across their entire business.
launches.body:
[https://youtu.be/BopUplmvTmo?si=jbSAqaSmyhjuVGyM](https://youtu.be/BopUplmvTmo?si=jbSAqaSmyhjuVGyMThe)

**Problem**\
We disagree with nearly every aspect of how AI solutions are being sold to enterprise clients today. Large consultancy budgets, big forward deployed teams, inventive outcomes based pricing models that feed off labour budgets. Specialised platform after specialised platform.

It feels like a transitory arbitrage opportunity; as an enterprise you get the bumper sticker but no durable advantage.

Lua makes it easy for teams to build out their own intelligent agent layer, leveraging insights and driving outcomes across their business without the $1m+ consulting contracts, tool fatigue or outcomes tax.

We want companies to own their own outcomes - not rent them.

**Our Platform**\
Lua makes it simple to roll out agents that are deeply integrated, measurable, and under your control across your entire business. Our platform abstracts all of the complexity required to launch enterprise grade agents and combines it with the tools needed for these agents to succeed in the real world.

Developer docs available here: https://docs.heylua.ai/overview

**Journey**\
We kicked off in March this year with a focus on building sales and support agents for SMBs that were integrated into their revenue engine and could be deployed in a couple of clicks across all their channels (web, app, instagram, messenger, whatsapp, etc). We built 300+ of these agents and quickly realised most partners wanted custom skills and deeper integrations to differentiate their agentic experience from their competitors and to truly succeed in the real world.

To solve this we built an abstraction layer that lets teams create their own skills and integrations on top of Lua that has quickly become our primary product.

**How We Grow**\
Distribution is where we win. We are a small team scaling simultaneously across the US, EMEA and South East Asia. We grow through developer agencies and channel partners, enabling distribution without a large enterprise sales motion or scaled forward deployed teams.

**Some of the things people are building on Lua:**

* Digital banks are re-designing their core around Lua’s intelligence layer
* On-demand delivery businesses use Lua to transition from app-based to chat first commerce
* Growth agencies are building inventive new ways to pre-qualify leads and optimise funnel performance
* Hotel booking engines are rolling out booking and concierge agents to their clients
* Large family businesses are weaving Lua into all of their existing systems and tools to automate processes and aggregate insights across their business verticals.

**The Team**\
Lua was founded by [@Lorcan O Cathain](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2558838) (CEO) and [@Stefan Kruger](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2558847) (CTO)- we’ve spent our careers scaling technology companies across emerging markets.

* We’d love you to build on Lua and get your feedback!
